invariants.rationale: The method always assigns a non-null HoodieWriteMetadata before returning, either from deleteExecutor.execute or by new HoodieWriteMetadata<>.
Regardless of branch, 'result' is always assigned and its write statuses field is set, so it should not be null.
deleteExecutor is used in all code paths, so it cannot be null at method exit.
config is used in all code paths (e.g., config.shouldCombineBeforeDelete()), so it must not be null.
getWriteStatuses() is assigned a List by design in the method's logic.
